title: Document Engram's task state model with Mermaid diagrams: lifecycle, derived availability, run and claim states, obligations and the completion flow
outcome: Document Engram's task state model with Mermaid diagrams: lifecycle, derived availability, run and claim states, obligations and the completion flow
acceptance: A Mermaid flowchart of the agent flow (add, claim, note/gate/host evidence, update, evaluate, done, seal; reopen; handoff) labels each gate's refusal with the words a receipt carries — the recovery-cause kinds missing_acceptance_evaluation, acceptance_insufficient_evidence, acceptance_failed, acceptance_evaluation_stale (and the other WorkCompletionRecoveryCause kinds) with their Rust names beside them, the acceptance_criteria_required error, and acceptance_evaluation_refused for the evaluate-time R5 refusal — and matches docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md

docs/features/local-work-system.md carries Mermaid state diagrams for WorkLifecycle (proposed/open/completed/cancelled/superseded with reopen), derived WorkAvailability (ready/claimed/active/blocked/deferred/waiting/closed) with its readiness reasons, WorkRunState and WorkClaimState with handoff, and WorkObligationState, each matching the enums in src/domain/work.rs
docs/shipped.md links the diagrams; the link check passes; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are untouched

completion.summary: Landed as 75a172f and cee0612 on origin/master: docs/features/local-work-system.md gains a State diagrams subsection (planning lifecycle; availability as the derivation's precedence with readiness reasons; run, claim and handoff states; obligations and per-criterion verdicts; the word-level flow with each gate's refusal in receipt words) and reconciles the older lifecycle sketch and waiting bullet; docs/shipped.md links it. Seven review rounds (Codex and Claude), every finding fixed and reviewed again; docs-only gate on each freeze; independent evaluation 569c8005 passed 3 of 3 after the first evaluation failed criterion 1 on internal names, corrected in cee0612. No install: documentation only.
